1.intro: Advent begins by looking ahead. Focus on chapters 21 and 22: a world made new. The Bible ends with a prayer we can make our own.

3.intro: God takes Abram outside and points to the night sky. Count the stars: that is how many descendants he will have, and he will be father of a multitude of nations.

family: What did God ask Abram to look at?
How do you feel when you wait?
What is one kind thing you can do this week?

3.closing: Hope grows as we learn to trust the One who makes the promises.

8.intro: Comfort for a weary people, and a voice calling in the wilderness.

15.intro: Good news to the poor, and many churches sing Mary's song today.

19.intro: The Word became human. Tonight's antiphon, O Wisdom, was sung each evening before Mary's song.

antiphon.title: O Wisdom
antiphon.prayer: O Wisdom, who came from the mouth of the Most High, reaching from one end of creation to the other and ordering all things with strength and gentleness: come and teach us the way of understanding.

22.intro: A throne forever. Many churches sing Mary's song today.

antiphon.title: O Key of David
antiphon.prayer: O Key of David, sceptre of the house of Israel, you open and no one can shut, you shut and no one can open: come and lead the prisoners out of the prison house, those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death.

finish.title: God with us
finish.body: Over these readings we have followed a story of promise. Jesus has come, Jesus is with us, and Jesus will come again.
